visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a metal bowl containing numerous clams submerged in water. A hand enters the frame to point at a clam while white and yellow Traditional Chinese text overlays introduce the topic of sand spitting. The setting is a clean, well-lit domestic kitchen with white cabinets. (2) The creator's hands hold the metal bowl, then pick up two clams to tap them against each other over a white plate. This physical action serves to demonstrate how to identify live clams by their solid sound. The camera remains at a close-up eye-level perspective, emphasizing the details of the shells. (3) A measuring cup of water is shown as a hand pours white salt from a small patterned dish into it. A red spoon is used to stir the mixture until the salt is fully dissolved. The brine is then poured into the bowl of clams, and the creator manually shakes the bowl. (4) Blue silicone ice trays are used to add ice cubes into the clam water. A subsequent time-jump shot shows the clams in the water with ice, with some shells partially open. The lighting is bright and consistent, highlighting the texture of the clams and the clarity of the water. (5) The creator washes the clams under a running kitchen faucet, rubbing them together vigorously with both hands to remove slime. They are then poured into a metal colander to drain. The background shows standard kitchen appliances and a clean sink area. (6) The drained clams are placed into a rectangular metal vacuum container. The creator uses a white manual pump on the lid, pumping several times to remove air. An alternative method is then shown using a clear plastic bag where air is squeezed out before being tied with a rubber band.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: @RosalinaKitchen. [Subtitle]: 如何正確的幫蛤蜊吐沙. (2) [Subtitle]: 讓蛤蜊探出頭來.... (3) [Subtitle]: 先把蛤蜊清洗乾淨. (4) [Subtitle]: 敲一敲確認是否還活著. (5) [Subtitle]: 聲音實心感像石頭的感覺.... (6) [Subtitle]: 聽起來空心表示可能不行了. (7) [Subtitle]: 抱歉，我這邊都是活的...😂. (8) [Subtitle]: 準備400ml的冷水加入3%的鹽. (9) [Subtitle]: 攪拌攪拌讓鹽溶解.... (10) [Subtitle]: 把鹽水倒進來. (11) [Subtitle]: 這鹽水呢就是模擬海水咸度. (12) [Subtitle]: 可以把鹽直接加到盆子裡這樣搖晃鹽就溶解了. (13) [Subtitle]: 夏天建議放一些冰塊避免蛤蜊臭掉. (14) [Subtitle]: 水量稍微蓋住蛤蜊即可. (15) [Subtitle]: 大約吐沙2個小時就差不多了. (16) [Subtitle]: 好囉，來去洗澡😍. (17) [Subtitle]: 水超髒.... (18) [Subtitle]: 換一盆乾淨的水. (19) [Subtitle]: 真的有吐沙喔.... (20) [Subtitle]: 清洗掉表面的黏液. (21) [Subtitle]: 瀝乾水分. [Slogan]: 水要瀝乾不要濕濕的. (22) [Subtitle]: 放到保鮮盒裡面. (23) [Subtitle]: 一定要抽真空這樣蛤蜊才能放一個禮拜喔😍. (24) [Subtitle]: 像這樣放冰箱，要用多少拿多少. (25) [Subtitle]: 沒有真空保鮮盒的話用塑膠袋也可以啦～. (26) [Subtitle]: 空氣都擠出去. (27) [Subtitle]: 袋口束緊用橡皮筋綁緊...也可以放3天....
